setup: Incline bench under the bar, about 30-45°
Bar lined up over your upper chest
Set the safety stops just above your chest
Grip a little wider than shoulder width
execution: Twist the bar to unhook it
Lower under control to your upper chest
Press straight up to straight arms
Twist to rehook at the top
faults: Don't bounce the bar off your chest
Don't flare your elbows straight out
Don't lift your hips off the bench

notes: Set the Smith machine's safety stops so the bar can't reach your chest or neck. With them set, you can train without a spotter.
Before loading, lower the empty bar to check it lands on your upper chest, not your neck or face.
The logged load is the plates added. Smith bars weigh different amounts in different gyms and some are counterbalanced, so loads aren't comparable with a barbell.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
